cloudflare_official_docs.evidence: Inbound Worker requests and CPU are separate meters; Worker-initiated subrequests add no request fee, while Standard Service Binding calls share the entry request and accumulate CPU across Workers; legacy Bundled/Unbound service-binding targets can incur another request. Worker cache hits still count as requests.
cloudflare_official_docs.title: Workers pricing

cloudflare_official_docs.evidence: Subrequests are runtime limits, not request-billing units; redirect chains may add subrequests. Service Binding invocation caps are also execution limits, not a price unit.
cloudflare_official_docs.title: Workers limits

related_pages.title: Service bindings — Runtime APIs
related_pages.evidence: Each Service Binding call counts against the caller subrequest limit; a request has at most 32 Worker invocations.

cloudflare_official_docs.evidence: Rows read count scanned rows regardless of row size; rows written include INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE; DDL may contribute rows; indexes add writes and can reduce reads; storage includes tables and indexes. D1 egress and per-hour compute are not D1 meters.
cloudflare_official_docs.title: D1 pricing

cloudflare_official_docs.evidence: Free caps differ from Paid overage.
cloudflare_official_docs.title: D1 FAQ

cloudflare_official_docs.evidence: Storage backend determines storage units: SQLite rows read/written plus stored data versus legacy key-value 4 KB read/write request units, list data examined, and per-delete request counting; setAlarm is a row write or one write request unit.
cloudflare_official_docs.title: Durable Objects pricing

cloudflare_official_docs.evidence: Alarm scheduling behavior; one alarm per object.
cloudflare_official_docs.title: Durable Objects alarms

cloudflare_official_docs.evidence: At-least-once handler; uncaught failures retry up to six times.

related_pages.title: SQLite-backed Durable Object Storage
related_pages.evidence: Storage operations/transactions provide atomicity and isolation within the DO storage boundary; setAlarm at/before Date.now schedules asynchronous execution in the immediate future.

related_pages.title: Access Durable Objects Storage
related_pages.evidence: In-memory state can be lost on eviction/restart; persist state that must survive.
